question_text: Ryan is picking Marvel movies from a Disney Plus. There's a Heroes Unite with 12 superhero and 13 villain, and a Dark Side with 8 superhero and 8 villain. Do the collections have the same ratio of superhero to villain?=_
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: To compare the ratios, write each collection's ratio as a fraction with superhero in the numerator and villain in the denominator. Heroes Unite: $\frac{12 \text{ superhero}}{13 \text{ villain}}$. Dark Side: $\frac{8 \text{ superhero}}{8 \text{ villain}}$.
Simplify the Heroes Unite ratio by dividing both numbers by their greatest common factor of 1: $\frac{12}{13} = \frac{12 \div 1}{13 \div 1} = \frac{12}{13}$
Simplify the Dark Side ratio by dividing both numbers by their greatest common factor of 8: $\frac{8}{8} = \frac{8 \div 8}{8 \div 8} = \frac{1}{1}$
Compare the simplified ratios: $\frac{12}{13}$ vs $\frac{1}{1}$. Since these fractions are not equal, the collections do not have the same ratio of superhero to villain.
